+import { createServerFn } from '@tanstack/react-start'
+import { addToCart, checkout, clearCart, getAnalytics, getCartTotals, getCategories, getDemoUserId, getFilterCounts, getPrompt, getPrompts, setFavorite, type ModelFilter, type SortKey } from '../db/marketplace'
+
+export const catalogServer = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' })
+  .validator((input: unknown) => (input ?? {}) as { model?: ModelFilter; category?: string; sort?: SortKey; search?: string; favoritesOnly?: boolean; freeOnly?: boolean })
+  .handler(async ({ data }) => ({
+    prompts: await getPrompts({ ...data, userId: getDemoUserId() }),
+    categories: await getCategories(),
+    counts: await getFilterCounts(),
+    cart: await getCartTotals(getDemoUserId()),
+  }))
+
+export const promptServer = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' })
+  .validator((input: unknown) => input as { id: number })
+  .handler(async ({ data }) => ({ prompt: await getPrompt(Number(data.id), getDemoUserId()) }))
+
+export const cartServer = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' })
+  .handler(async () => ({ cart: await getCartTotals(getDemoUserId()) }))
+
+export const addCartServer = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' })
+  .validator((input: unknown) => input as { id: number })
+  .handler(async ({ data }) => ({ cart: await addToCart(Number(data.id), getDemoUserId()) }))
+
+export const favoriteServer = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' })
+  .validator((input: unknown) => input as { id: number; favorite: boolean })
+  .handler(async ({ data }) => ({ prompt: await setFavorite(Number(data.id), Boolean(data.favorite), getDemoUserId()) }))
+
+export const checkoutServer = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' })
+  .handler(async () => checkout(getDemoUserId()))
+
+export const clearCartServer = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' })
+  .handler(async () => ({ cart: await clearCart(getDemoUserId()) }))
+
+export const analyticsServer = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' })
+  .handler(async () => getAnalytics())
*** End Patch
